{{dts|March 28, 1979}}: Loss of coolant and partial core meltdown, see Three Mile Island accident and Three Mile Island accident health effects
{{dts|March 9, 1985}}: Instrumentation systems malfunction during startup, which led to suspension of operations at all three Units
{{dts|April 11, 1986}}: Recurring equipment problems force emergency shutdown of Boston Edison's plant
{{dts|March 31, 1987}}: Units 2 and 3 shutdown due to cooling malfunctions and unexplained equipment problems
{{dts|December 19, 1987}}: Malfunctions force Niagara Mohawk Power Corporation to shut down Unit 1
{{dts|February 20, 1996}}: Leaking valve forces shutdown of Units 1 and 2, multiple equipment failures found
{{dts|September 2, 1996}}: Balance-of-plant equipment malfunction forces shutdown and extensive repairs
{{dts|February 1, 2010}}: Deteriorating underground pipes leak radioactive tritium into groundwater supplies
